research_rationale:
EO 11076 (January 15, 1963, signed by John F. Kennedy, Establishing the President's Advisory Commission on Narcotic and Drug Abuse, printed at 28 FR 477-478), read in full in the registered Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11076.txt (machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, PDF pages 7 and 8, graded original_representation_unverified and counted as an official original; number, title and date agree with the census register; I did not inspect the PDF page images). Content: section 1 establishes the Commission (up to seven members appointed from outside the executive branch, a Chairman and an Executive Director); section 2 sets its functions, including a report with legislative recommendations (an interim report not later than April 1, 1963) and a review of Federal agency programs; section 3 requires named Cabinet officers to designate liaison representatives, to assist the Commission and to transmit legislative recommendations not later than February 28, 1963; section 4 sets compensation and personnel; section 5 provides for payment of expenses from the Special Projects appropriation for 1963 and the corresponding appropriation for fiscal year 1964; section 6 requires the final report by November 1, 1963 and provides that the Commission shall terminate not later than December 31, 1963. Inventory: the dossier has six scopes covering sections 1 through 6 without a gap; the last scope, labelled section 4, runs through the end of section 6 and so holds the termination sentence. I accept it as complete. First end: the order own sunset. All six clauses serve the Commission, so each ended when the Commission terminated, recorded as 1963-12-31 inclusive. The interim report date (April 1, 1963), the February 28, 1963 transmission date and the final report date (November 1, 1963) are deadlines for single acts, each recorded as a deadline and not an end; no held source gives the actual dates the acts were performed. Later events: none found. The three selected machine searches have no hit for this order. A citation search of the 33,118 held order texts under jobs/*/output/texts (clause-drafts excluded) for the forms Executive Order 11076, Order No. 11076 and E.O. 11076 finds the order own capture and the capture file for EO 11075, which holds the same Federal Register pages (PDF page 7 of 40) and so contains this order as page text; it is not a later order. The held text of EO 12553 (51 FR 7237) does not print the number 11076 in its table. The standing disclosure that this order rests on a Federal Register OCR text layer and not on an authenticated original applies.

savings.reason: The order has no savings or transition language. Compensation and expenses for work done before December 31, 1963 became payable under section 5 and the appropriation law, which are not continuing commands of the order; no right or duty is preserved by the order itself after the Commission ended.
